findings.one_line: The finite set is defined to contain only facet-normal rays, but at d=0 (and other lower-dimensional images) compatibility also requires affine-hull equalities; treating each equality as two supporting half-spaces in the proof does not put their non-facet normals in R*, so its advertised finite facet test can accept nu outside P_{mu,d}.
